description: This file defines the PollyClient class, a client for interacting with the Amazon Polly service via the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for voice synthesis and URL signing, extending the base AWS client.

classes.name: PollyClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Polly services, supporting speech synthesis, lexicon management, and presigned URL generation.

methods.name: createSynthesizeSpeechPreSignedUrl
methods.description: Generates a pre-signed URL for the SynthesizeSpeech operation, allowing temporary access to speech synthesis without requiring explicit credentials.
